descriptions.zh: **请确保在使用该接口前，已充分了解EAS产品的收费方式和[价格](~~144261~~)。**
descriptions.en: **Before calling this API, make sure you understand the billing method and [pricing](~~144261~~) of Elastic Algorithm Service (EAS).**

example.unifiedCli: aliyun eas create-resource --ecs-instance-type ecs.c6.8xlarge --system-disk-size 200 --ecs-instance-count 5 --charge-type PostPaid --auto-renewal false --zone cn-shanghai-f --resource-type Dedicated --self-managed-resource-options '{"RoleName":"clusterrole","NodeTolerations":[{"effect":"NoSchedule","value":"value1","key":"key1","operator":"Equal"}],"NodeMatchLabels":{"key":"example-string"},"ExternalClusterId":"cf0386f250f2545689ca7fdd1cd000000"}' --labels key=example-string --resource-name MyResource --usage-mode example-string --region cn-hangzhou
